name: Justiciar
intro: The Justiciar pathway represents judgment, law, restriction and authority. It specializes in suppressing abilities, enforcing rules and controlling supernatural combat.

meter.name: Law
meter.full: Cancel and punish one forbidden action

ability.name: Deterrent Aura
ability.label: Passive
ability.description: Deterrent Aura — +10% DEF; +10% Psychic direct-damage resistance. Passive.

ability.name: Fines & Penalties
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Fines & Penalties — Deals 155% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Piercing damage (22% base DEF bypass); Immediately drains up to 10 target SP plus 5% of target Max SP; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 15 SP · Cooldown 2 turns.

ability.name: Prohibition Barrier
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Prohibition Barrier — Grants a 20% Max HP shield; lasts until depleted or dispelled; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 25 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Interdiction Zone
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Interdiction Zone — For 2 turns, prohibit enemy healing and shields. Violating actions pay their normal costs and trigger a judgment; full charge strengthens one judgment.; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 35 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Law Enforcement
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Law Enforcement — Deals 210% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Piercing damage (22% base DEF bypass); If the target has a stat buff, it takes +20% incoming damage for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 45 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Imperator's Decree
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Imperator's Decree — Deals 230% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Piercing damage (22% base DEF bypass); Blocks target living-unit healing for 2 turns; resurrection remains possible; Blocks new target shields for 2 turns; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 50 SP · Cooldown 3 turns.

ability.name: Strict Prohibition
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Strict Prohibition — 100% chance: Silenced for 1 turn; subject to status resistance and immunity; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 65 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Executioner Stance
ability.label: Active Stance
ability.description: Executioner Stance — +25% ATK for 2 turns; +30% DEF bypass for 2 turns; If the resolved cast deals no damage, follows its utility effects with a 35% basic strike against the current enemy. 85 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Decree of Abolition
ability.label: Active
ability.description: Decree of Abolition — Deals 320% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) Piercing damage (22% base DEF bypass); Removes current stat buffs, Guarded, Evade and shields; Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 100 SP · Cooldown 4 turns.

ability.name: Absolute Prohibition
ability.label: Active Authority
ability.description: Absolute Prohibition — Deals 460% × (105% ATK + 30% INT) True damage (ignores DEF and elemental resistance); Damage and hostile effects use accuracy and Dodge; critical, authority and defense modifiers still apply. 125 SP · Cooldown 5 turns.
